messages.content: You are BioGPT, an expert compiler architect. Translate the provided natural language biological protocol into valid, deterministic BioScript code for execution on a microfluidic biochip.

Source link: https://www.mdpi.com/1424-8220/17/11/2616/pdf
Paper DOI: https://doi.org/10.3390/s17112616

Protocol details:

ASSAY TYPE: Digital Microfluidics Platform for Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Detection (DMF-LAMP) for c-Myc Oncogene Amplification

REAGENTS USED:
  - LAMPMix (LAMP reaction reagents: 0.8 uM each inner primer FIP and BIP, 0.2 uM each outer primer FP and BP, 0.4 mM dNTP mix, 1 M betaine, 4 mM MgCl2, 1x supplied buffer, 8 U Bst DNA polymerase large fragment; 0.14 uL per droplet)
  - DNASample (target c-Myc proto-oncogene DNA resuspended in 1x enzyme buffer at 0.5 ng/uL; 0.14 uL per droplet)

STEPS:
1. Reagent dispensing: Dispense 10 droplets (~0.14 uL each, ~1.40 uL total) of LAMPMix from the left reservoir and transport to the central reaction reservoir via zig-zag electrodes.
2. Sample dispensing: Dispense 1 droplet (~0.14 uL) of DNASample from the right reservoir and transport to the central reaction reservoir.
3. Mixing: Merge and mix the LAMP reagent and DNA sample droplets in the central reaction reservoir (total on-chip reaction volume: 1.54 uL; final DNA concentration: 0.5 ng/uL).
4. First incubation: Incubate the reaction droplet isothermally at 65 C for 15 min (bottom-plate set point; vertical temperature gradient across droplet: 0.3 C; mixing region electrodes kept activated at 20 VRMS, 5 kHz).
5. First amplification check: Assess amplification by fluorescence readout (standing in for gel-electrophoresis band intensity).
6. Second incubation: If no amplification detected, continue isothermal incubation at 65 C for a further 15 min (cumulative 30 min).
7. Second amplification check: Assess amplification again.
8. Third incubation: If still no amplification detected, continue isothermal incubation at 65 C for a further 15 min (cumulative 45 min).
9. Third amplification check: Assess amplification again. If still negative, discard the reaction droplet.
10. Product retrieval: On successful amplification, transport the reaction product droplet to the retrieving reservoir and withdraw from the device via pipette.

INTERPRETATION: Successful c-Myc LAMP amplification is confirmed by the appearance of a characteristic LAMP ladder band pattern on gel electrophoresis (Figure 3e, Lane 7, positive at 45 min cumulative incubation). The on-chip DMF-LAMP product shows higher normalized band fluorescence intensity (139.0 a.u.) than the equivalent bench-top reaction (78.8 a.u.), indicating enhanced amplification efficiency in the miniaturized DMF format. Negative controls show no amplification at any time point. The platform achieves sensitive amplification of 0.5 ng/uL target DNA in 1.54 uL total volume in 45 min.

bsbbif_2_t:
	heat(LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 65.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	Amp_Check_301[0] = detect(fluorescence, LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if Amp_Check_301[0] <= 80	|	true: jump bsbbif_4_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_5_f
bsbbif_3_f:
	PHI Amp_Check_453 = {Amp_Check_450,Amp_Check_452}
	PHI LAMP_Reaction4 = {LAMP_Reaction1,LAMP_Reaction3}
	PHI Amp_Check_302 = {Amp_Check_300,Amp_Check_301}
	dispose(LAMP_Reaction4[0])
	NOP
main:
	reagent1[0] = dispense(LAMPMix)
	sample1[0] = dispense(DNASample)
	LAMP_Reaction1[0] = mix(reagent1[0], sample1[0])
	heat(LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 65.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	Amp_Check_151[0] = detect(fluorescence, LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if Amp_Check_151[0] <= 80	|	true: jump bsbbif_2_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_3_f
bsbbif_4_t:
	heat(LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 65.0CELSIUS @ 900.0SECOND
	Amp_Check_451[0] = detect(fluorescence, LAMP_Reaction1[0]) @ 30.0SECOND
	if Amp_Check_451[0] <= 80	|	true: jump bsbbif_6_t	|	false: jump bsbbif_7_f
bsbbif_5_f:
	PHI Amp_Check_452 = {Amp_Check_450,Amp_Check_451}
	PHI LAMP_Reaction3 = {LAMP_Reaction1,LAMP_Reaction2}
	jump: bsbbif_3_f
bsbbif_6_t:
	dispose(LAMP_Reaction1[0])
bsbbif_7_f:
	PHI LAMP_Reaction2 = {LAMP_Reaction1,LAMP_Reaction}
	jump: bsbbif_5_f

numeric_mismatches.note: Detection in the paper is gel electrophoresis band fluorescence intensity. The threshold of 80 a.u. is derived from the bench-top positive control band intensity (78.8 a.u.) reported in Section 3.4; values at or below this represent no amplification. BioScript's 'detect fluorescence' is used as the sole available detect primitive; it stands in for the gel-electrophoresis readout rather than a real-time fluorescence signal.

numeric_mismatches.field: zig-zag electrode actuation and circular mixing
numeric_mismatches.note: The paper describes zig-zag crenelated electrodes improving droplet transport (Section 2.1) and the mixing reservoir kept activated during LAMP (Section 3.4). BioScript has no spatial actuation primitive; these are folded into the dispense and mix operations with no positional detail.

The paper characterizes a 0.3 C vertical temperature gradient across the droplet at 65 C bottom-plate set point (Section 3.2). BioScript's heat primitive specifies only a single temperature; the gradient and PID controller are hardware-level details not expressible in the language.

numeric_mismatches.field: bench-top optimization, velocity characterization, impedance monitoring, bench-top comparison
numeric_mismatches.note: Not modeled. Sections 2.3-2.4, 3.1-3.2, and Figure 3a-b/3f describe optimization and characterization sub-experiments run alongside but separate from the core on-chip protocol, and fall outside the scope of this translation.

metadata.notes: This protocol details Digital Microfluidics Platform for Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Detection (DMF-LAMP) for c-Myc Oncogene Amplification. The assay is performed on a Digital Microfluidics (DMF) platform. Key reagents used in the assay include LAMPMix and DNASample.
